title: Light Blue Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Light Blue account debit card terms: APY is 0% and the debit card daily purchase limit is $2,500. It explains how to manage limits (plan large purchases, contact us for amounts above $2,500) and notes that split transactions and pending authorizations affect the $2,500 total.
faqs: What is the Light Blue account APY?
What is the Light Blue debit card daily purchase limit?
What should I do if I need to make a debit card purchase over $2,500 in one day?
Can I split a purchase into multiple transactions to stay under $2,500?
Do pending debit card transactions count toward the $2,500 limit?
keywords: contact us in advance for purchases above $2,500
split transactions (only if merchant allows separate authorizations)
pending card transactions count toward limit until settle/drop off
